description.value: Tre Galli Gelato Caffe is a family-run Italian café founded in 2004 by the three Gallo brothers, offering handmade artisan gelato, sorbetto, LaVazza coffee, pizza, and pastries at their New Westminster Quayside Drive location. The café has both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a comfortable mid-ride stop for cyclists exploring the Fraser River waterfront. Their gelato is made in-house to authentic Italian recipes, with a rotating selection of flavours including dairy-free sorbetto.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 46m; stands (10 spaces) at 49m; stands (8 spaces, covered) at 52m. Total: 18 spaces.
